name: Fujimiya Tomoya
source: Tomoya is a good and reliable guy who has achieved considerable success in Aikido. He'll never leave the girl in trouble. So it's not surprising that the girls around are fell in love with him. Moreover, his father gave him a task of finding himself a wife. However, Tomoya does not always understand the subtle hints that he gets in a great variety from the girls.
